reason: The plan hits every hard requirement (12-step numbered list, dry run/rehearsal, post-cutover checksum/row-count verification, stakeholder communication, pre-modification full backups, and a conditional rollback) in a logically sequenced, technically credible order, with the rehearsal explicitly used to validate that the 2-hour window is achievable. It is actionable and specific enough for a real migration, though it stops short of deeper detail on WAL/point-in-time recovery options or quantified acceptable replication lag thresholds.
